captions.detailed: A matte-black tilt-shift camera lens assembly consisting of a rear square mounting block, a mid bellows-like tilt stage, and a cylindrical front optical block. A small side adjustment knob is mounted on a short cylindrical shaft extending from the right side of the main housing. The front optical block can tilt relative to the rear mount via a revolute joint, while the side locking knob can rotate continuously.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a tilt-shift camera lens with a square rear mounting plate, a mid bellows section, and a cylindrical front optical barrel. Add a side-mounted continuous rotating locking knob, and define a revolute joint allowing the front barrel to tilt relative to the base.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a square box combined with a rear mounting cylinder. Model the bellows/tilt stage using a series of concentric, alternating-diameter cylinders to simulate ridges. Create the front optical block as a large hollow cylinder. Construct the side locking knob using a small cylinder for the shaft and a larger thin cylinder with a chamfered edge for the grip. Define a revolute joint for the front barrel's tilt axis and a continuous joint for the side knob.
